note: Finished events the model learns from. Drop a Luma guest export in this folder, name it starting with the event date (2026-08-12-princeton.csv), and add a line below. On GitHub Pages this folder is also read directly from the repo, so the manifest is only a fallback. Optional per-event keys: label, date, tz, region, venue, lat, lon.
venueNote: lat and lon are the event venue, used for the distance predictor. An event with no coordinates still trains group booking and lead time; it simply contributes nothing to the distance term, and its families are scored at the average distance effect. Add coordinates when you can: look up the venue, right-click the pin in any map app, and paste the pair. The venue field is free text for humans and is not parsed.
